name: full-live-responsive-stability-fix
changes: Customer Home/Exclusive/Messages/Wallet/Profile navigation is fixed to the bottom on desktop, tablet and mobile with page padding so it never cuts through content.
Customer listener cards use improved margins, padding, avatar/copy hierarchy and responsive desktop/tablet/mobile grids.
Wallet plans use six cards per normal laptop/desktop row, five on compact laptops, four on tablets and two on phones with compact consistent card sizing.
Customer Account & Security is re-spaced with a compact verified-phone panel, aligned password form and cleaner delete/logout actions.
Listener login/start is a true full listener page on desktop/tablet instead of a floating card, while the compact phone layout is preserved.
Listener voice verification is a separate full-page step after signup/login and displays the exact admin-saved Malayalam prompt.
Unapproved listeners can access only voice-verification routes until admin approval; normal listener workspace APIs remain locked.
OTP registration, forgot-password and pre-login support use MSG91; returning same-role phone numbers return to password login instead of creating duplicate accounts.
Pre-login customer/listener support now verifies with MSG91 and supports 4-6 digit widget OTP lengths.
Listener online mode now checks microphone permission before advertising availability; customer call requests also preflight microphone permission.
WebRTC uses multiple STUN servers, pooled ICE candidates and remote-audio resume handling; TURN environment support remains available for restrictive networks.
Listener inbox, wallet, profile, settings, posts, full-screen post feed and calling surfaces are normalized to the light theme with responsive containment.
Report, support, verification, availability and calling routes were statically traced end-to-end and cache/version identifiers are bumped to 8.9.17.
